body:
Hi,

Two issues here:

1/ the documentation is a live example where all the widgets are working against the same instantsearch instance. And yes it feels really weird that the page is constantly moving on some widgets.

**To fix this**: we could instantiate one instantsearch instance per widget in the documentation, thus they are no more linked and it will be good. That is not a big deal at all to have them in separate instances since there's no way you can understand they are linked (thus the issue)

2/ The second issue is linked to the 1. in fact, if the slider was the sole widget of a single instance the behavior would be different. What you are seeing here is that the rangeSlider and priceRange widgets are acting on the same attribute (price). This is why this is weird (ref #327)
